_comment: Issue/PR labels as code. Applied idempotently by scripts/apply-github-presence.sh (create-or-update; never deletes). Colors are hex without '#'. The release-notes categories in .github/release.yml and the ISSUE_TEMPLATE forms reference these names — keep them in sync.

labels.name: bug
labels.description: A defect in the product (never a vulnerability report - those are private, see SECURITY.md)

labels.name: connector
labels.description: A new or improved source/output connector (Apache-2.0, imports only from sdk/)

labels.name: security
labels.description: Security-relevant change landing after coordinated disclosure (reports themselves are private, see SECURITY.md)

labels.name: breaking
labels.description: Breaking change - requires a migration note in the PR and CHANGELOG

labels.name: good first issue
labels.description: Small, well-scoped, a good entry point to the codebase

labels.name: duplicate
labels.description: This issue or PR already exists

labels.name: wontfix
labels.description: This will not be worked on (reason in the closing comment)

labels.name: skip-changelog
labels.description: Exclude this PR from the auto-generated release notes
